task.title: How to Report a Phishing Email
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to safely report suspicious emails or text messages to NC State OIT Cybersecurity Operations.

context.p: Reporting suspected phishing messages helps NC State OIT block malicious senders and protect the broader campus community.
context.note: Do not reply to the sender, click any links, download attachments, or approve unexpected Duo 2FA prompts.

step.cmd: Report the message using NC State Gmail's built-in reporting tool.

info.p: Open the suspicious email in NC State Gmail on a computer, click the More icon (three vertical dots) in the top-right corner of the message pane, and select Report phishing. This sends the message headers directly to Google and NC State OIT Cybersecurity Operations.

step.cmd: Notify NC State OIT if you need assistance or suspect targeted campus activity.

info.p: If you have questions about a suspicious message or cannot use Gmail's built-in button, contact the NC State Help Desk at 919-515-HELP (4357), submit a request through the NC State IT Service Portal, or send details to phishing@ncsu.edu.

step.cmd: Forward fraudulent text messages (smishing) to your mobile carrier.

info.p: If you receive a suspicious text message on your phone, forward it to the short code 7726 (SPAM) and follow the automated carrier prompt to submit the sender's phone number.

step.cmd: Take immediate action if you clicked a link or entered your credentials.

info.p: If you entered your Unity password on a suspicious page or downloaded an unknown file, immediately change your Unity password, disconnect the device from the network if malware is suspected, and call the NC State Help Desk at 919-515-HELP (4357).

result.p: The suspicious message is removed from your inbox and routed to NC State OIT Cybersecurity Operations for investigation and campus-wide blocking.
